name: Harness Code
description: Every message: the agent answers code-structure questions with the Harness Code tools before grep.

action.text: For questions about code structure, call the Harness Code tools before grep or file reads, with project_path: code_map for an area (focus = the path the request names), code_symbol for a name, code_impact before changing a signature or behaviour, code_path for how A reaches B. Use grep and file reads for literal text and for details the graph does not show. Status line: "Code: code_map ui/src/hooks" or "Code: no code question".
